ability.name: Ice Scramble
ability.note: Before using this Pokémon, you may move this Pokémon on the bench next to one of your [CTRL FID 328][Avalugg] on the field. If you do, this Pokémon's MP is 1. Frozen Pokémon next to this Pokémon cannot be tagged.

wheel.name: Double-Edge
wheel.note: This Pokémon and the battle opponent are knocked out.

wheel.name: Harden
wheel.note: *If the battle opponent spins an Attack of 100 damage or less, this Pokémon is not knocked out. While this Pokémon is on the field, the Attacks of this Pokémon, other than Harden, deal +10 damage.

wheel.name: Ice Fang
wheel.note: *If this Pokémon is knocked out, the battle opponent becomes frozen.
